rationale: The candidate reads as a compact folded mass with some dominant central continuity, but it does not convincingly resolve as one usable long-span gymnasium hall. In all views the form remains visually compressed and somewhat conflicted: the roof/upper profile is faceted and irregular rather than clearly spanning, while the ground relationship is sealed and offers little legible public void or entry seam on the frontage. The geometry has moderate coherence in isolation, but the multi-view massing suggests overlapping folds and a stacked object more than a hall with subordinate support/service logic. Because the program brief demands a clear-span hall with roof/section logic and an active public ground response, the current form fails program-fit even though it is not completely incoherent.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low, elongated sports building can read as a single clear hall with a strong horizontal datum and a sheltered public edge.
